targetWords.anchor: Clew Bay as a maritime world
The fleet that works the sea

resources.value: Tá an long ar an bhfarraige.

pages.title: The sea that names this coast
pages.body: On Clew Bay the open water is farraige. The same word returns in different surrounds — on a ship, and as the sea that is here.
pages.detail: D30 fixture copy only. Two invented pedagogical surrounds stay unreviewed.

pages.title: Keep farraige; change the surround
pages.context: Tá an long ar an bhfarraige → Tá an fharraige anseo
pages.body: Hear the ship on the sea. Build a different Clew Bay line that still uses farraige.

exercise.objective: Produce a Clew Bay location line with farraige after hearing the lexeme in a ship surround.
exercise.prompt: Hear the ship on the sea. Build: The sea is here.
exercise.audioText: Tá an long ar an bhfarraige.
exercise.feedback: Same lexeme, new surround — the sea that is here on this coast.
exercise.hint: Keep the location frame Tá an … anseo, with farraige lenited after an.
exercise.recovery: You heard bhfarraige on a ship. Build Tá an fharraige anseo — location, not the ship line.
